standard_prerequisites.name: Normalization factorization
standard_prerequisites.use: The integral cover with local factorization through U.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finiteness over an open
standard_prerequisites.use: Quasi-finite over a quasi-compact open is finite after shrinking.

standard_prerequisites.name: Schematic image of open immersions
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, lemma composition-integral (cross-chapter, named)

core_obligations: Start from the integral cover with local factorization through the etale U -> X.
On the locus where the factorization is defined the morphism is quasi-finite over a quasi-compact open; shrink to make it finite.
The shrunk open is dense since the factorization is scheme-theoretically dense.
Conclude: a dense open of X over which the cover is finite.
proof_roadmap: Integral cover; quasi-finite-to-finite shrink; density; conclusion.
difficulty_reason: A three-step shrink argument combining the carded integral cover with the scheme finiteness lemma.
